title: Schema.org
authority: Schema.org (W3C Community Group; Google, Microsoft, Yahoo, Yandex)
usedFor: Universal web fallback — generic metadata, dates, ratings, observations. Candidate `schema:` prefix for this project's JSON-LD context.
source: Third-party vocabulary survey. Schema.org's own terms page has not been read for the terms we use.
finding: This project's JSON-LD context used to map `createdAt -> schema:dateCreated` and `updatedAt -> schema:dateModified` with no provenance record. Both were plausible and neither was verified — `dateCreated`/`dateModified` carry Schema.org's own semantics about a CreativeWork, and whether those match a passport record's lifecycle timestamps is exactly the kind of near-miss that a machine consumer acts on and a human never re-reads — so both were removed on 2026-08-10 in favour of `dpp:createdAt`/`dpp:updatedAt`.
nextStep: Read Schema.org's definitions of `dateCreated` and `dateModified` and decide whether they mean what our lifecycle timestamps mean. If they do, restore the `schema:` mapping as a verified entry; if not, the `dpp:` terms stay the honest choice.
